# Basket app notes

- This is a mobile-first React + TypeScript app built with Vite.
- Shopping lists and compressed label photos are stored in browser localStorage for this demo.
- OCR uses Tesseract.js in the browser; OCR values must be confirmed or edited before adding an item.
- Account registration is device-local demo authentication, not production authentication. Do not describe it as secure or synced.
- Run `npm run build` to validate and `npm run dev` to start the local development server.
